_comment: Pre-screen input: fresh macro/pre-market conditions + per-stock news, from reliable sources. NEWS GOES STALE - refresh before relying on it. To refresh: web-search current futures/VIX/yields/oil + headlines and each stock's latest news, then rewrite this file with today's date, numbers, and source links. prescreen.py and overall.py read this; they do NOT fetch news themselves. Trigger keyword: Pre-screen.

macro.summary: Recovery rally after Thursday's FOMC-driven selloff: S&P +1.08%, Nasdaq +1.91%, Russell 2000 +2.1% leading as tech/cyclicals lift the tape; VIX easing to ~17.2. Oil near its lowest since early March on the signed US-Iran interim peace deal. Headwind: a hawkish Fed (held rates but ~half the FOMC now expects at least one 2026 hike); 10y back up to ~4.49%.
